info.title: Polaris API
info.description: Historical and realtime market data from Polaris.

get.summary: Read execution-price candles for a DEX pool
get.description: Requires a Polaris API key and an explicitly published candle source. Sparse UTC windows use token0 as base and token1 as quote. Prices are decimal strings rounded to 38 significant digits; volumes and price ratios retain exact values in candle_json. Intervals 5m, 15m, 1h and 1d are computed from current minute candles. start/end are aligned Unix milliseconds, with end exclusive. Requests are limited to one day and 1000 output windows. Empty windows are absent. Coverage is observed unless independently reconciled; window closure does not assert chain finality. Query and response-byte allowances are shared with /data. Multiple read pages are not a database snapshot.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Published source: uniswap-v2, uniswap-v3 or uniswap-v4

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive aligned UTC window start in milliseconds

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Exclusive aligned UTC window end in milliseconds

get.summary: List stored tables, schemas, and time bounds
get.description: Return a cached inventory of every table and view in the configured standard database on the primary and metadata nodes, plus registered public source databases on the primary node. Includes empty tables, column names and types, physical row counts where available, and timestamp bounds from part indexes or ordered boundary reads. Exact optional filters are combined with AND. No event-table aggregation is performed. Bounds are null for empty tables or when unavailable. Table objects contain only database, table, row_count, start, end, and columns; column objects contain only name and type. Standard metadata observation times are not event-history coverage. Internal and canary databases and hidden sources are excluded. Tables at the two node locations remain separate. No API key is required.

200.description: Table inventory, refreshed every 10 minutes by default

429.description: The per-client request quota was exceeded

get.summary: Read filtered rows from a public table
get.description: Requires a Polaris API key. The table path is database.table, for example standard.trades or hyperliquid.raw__trades. Uses the SQL public table allowlist, not the full coverage inventory. Filters use column=value or column.eq=value, column.gte=value, and column.lte=value, combined with AND. Equality supports scalar strings, numbers, booleans and dates; inclusive ranges support numeric and date/time columns. Nullable and LowCardinality scalar types are supported. Nested JSON paths, null predicates and SQL expressions are unsupported. Reserved controls are start, end, limit and cursor; use column.eq for reserved column names. start/end accept RFC 3339 or Unix milliseconds and filter collector_timestamp, observed_at for market_metadata, or window_start_ms for source-owned candles. Omitted bounds impose no time restriction. Conflicting shortcuts, duplicate predicates, unknown columns and reversed bounds return 400. Reads use FINAL, or a current-window view for source-owned candles, and return stored columns with ClickHouse lossless JSON encoding, including quoted 64-bit integers and decimals. Raw and event results are ordered by collector time and stable identifiers; metadata by source/market. Cursor requests must repeat the same normalized filters. Cursors are not snapshot locks. Each successful response consumes the existing monthly delivered-byte allowance. Results have a 16 MiB limit; query execution and admission limits are shared with SQL. Always available with provisioned restricted readers; there is no data feature flag. HEAD never executes a query.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive collector/observation start: RFC 3339 or Unix milliseconds

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Inclusive collector/observation end: RFC 3339 or Unix milliseconds

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor; repeat the original filters

get.summary: Run a bounded read-only ClickHouse SELECT query
get.description: API keys are optional. Anonymous reads are restricted on every underlying event/raw table to the inclusive collector_timestamp interval [request time minus seven days, request time]; joins, CTEs, subqueries and aggregates cannot bypass this filter. standard.market_metadata has no time restriction. Supplied credentials must be valid API keys; authenticated reads have unrestricted history and are billed, anonymous responses are not billed. Missing LIMIT defaults to 100 result rows; simple single-table event/raw row reads default to collector_timestamp DESC unless ORDER BY is supplied. Aggregate, distinct, join and set queries retain their ordering semantics. Explicit LIMIT and ORDER BY are respected within the existing result cap. Queries published standard tables (including market_metadata) and registered production raw__ tables. Unqualified names resolve to standard. Supports joins, CTEs, unions, windows, and FINAL; stored rows are not automatically deduplicated. Only reviewed built-in functions are supported. SETTINGS, FORMAT, table functions, external sources, and output destinations are rejected. For authenticated requests, the complete JSON envelope is charged to the existing monthly response-byte quota. Results are limited to 1,000 rows and 16 MiB; failures return no partial data and consume no response-byte allowance. Execution is limited to 25 seconds and 64 GiB scanned. Disabled until the separate SQL deployment is provisioned.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: One SELECT statement, at most 4 KiB UTF-8; total URL-encoded request target at most 8 KiB

401.description: A Polaris API key is required

405.description: Only GET is supported; HEAD does not execute SQL

422.description: Query work or result limit exceeded

429.description: Monthly allowance, rate limit, or SQL concurrency exceeded

503.description: SQL disabled or a dependency is unavailable

get.description: Upgrade to the Polaris WebSocket feed for realtime market-data subscriptions. Client and server message schemas are defined by the x-websocket extension.

total.description: Number of tables after filtering. Empty tables and views are included.

row_count.description: Physical rows before pending deduplication; null if unavailable.

start.description: Part-index bounds, not a guarantee of uninterrupted history.

resolution.description: Action the caller can take to resolve or recover from the failure.

expires_at.description: Intent expiry time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

settled_at.description: Settlement time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

raw_reference_sequence.description: Collector sequence of the sibling row containing the exact raw payload.

exchange_timestamp.description: Always null: a baseline is synthetic, not a new venue observation.

unit.description:
Concrete asset/currency symbol when known (for example `BTC`, `USDC`,
or `USD`); dimensionless values use names such as `percent`.

raw_reference_sequence.description: Collector sequence of the sibling row containing the exact raw payload.

collector_timestamp.description: Collector-arrival time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

exchange_timestamp.description: Venue-provided event time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

raw.description: Exact upstream JSON payload; omitted for synthesized full books.

raw_reference_sequence.description: Collector sequence of the sibling row containing the exact raw payload.

type.description: `orderbook`; inspect `data.is_snapshot` to distinguish snapshots from deltas.

funding_rate.description: Venue-published rate or estimate for the closest upcoming settlement.

funding_timestamp.description: Closest upcoming settlement time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

predicted_funding_rate.description: Venue-published forecast for the settlement after the closest one.

raw_reference_sequence.description: Collector sequence of the sibling row containing the exact raw payload.

collector_timestamp.description: Collector-arrival time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

exchange_timestamp.description: Venue-provided event time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

raw.description: Exact upstream JSON payload, when this row was directly derived from one.

raw_reference_sequence.description: Collector sequence of the sibling row containing the exact raw payload.

data.description: Values use ClickHouse JSON encodings; each row follows `columns` order.

token.description: Optional Privy access token or Polaris API key; requires `stream:read`.

SubscriptionRequest.description: One exact persisted table/filter subscription and optional resume position.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previously delivered data page; subscribe only.
Save only after processing every row in this page. Reconnect may replay overlap.

maker.description: Maker account or address identifier, when published by the venue.

taker.description: Taker account or address identifier, when published by the venue.

collector_timestamp.description: Collector-arrival time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

exchange_timestamp.description: Venue-provided event time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

raw.description: Exact upstream JSON payload, when this row was directly derived from one.

raw_reference_sequence.description: Collector sequence of the sibling row containing the exact raw payload.

bearerAuth.description: Privy access token or Polaris API key

RateLimitPolicy.description: The quota policy applied to this request, expressed as an IETF structured field.

RateLimit.description: The remaining quota and effective reset window for this request.

RateLimitLimit.description: Compatibility field containing the request quota for the current window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Compatibility field containing the unused request quota in the current window.

RateLimitReset.description: Compatibility field containing whole seconds until the current window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying a rate-limited request.

PolarisMonthlyUsageLimit.description: Billable response-byte allowance for the current subscription period.

PolarisMonthlyUsageRemaining.description: Billable response bytes remaining in the current subscription period.

PolarisMonthlyUsageReset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the subscription usage period resets.
